children: Oil rises in early Asian trade as Houthi militants' attack on Saudi Arabia's energy infrastructure amplifies fears over supply disruptions in the Middle East. Iran-backed Houthi militants in Yemen fired drones and missiles at a number of Saudi Arabia's southern energy facilities. Saudi Arabia confirmed the attacks, which the Houthis said targeted facilities in Abha, Najran and Jazan. "The recent escalation in attacks has weighed on oil flows from the Persian Gulf," ANZ Research analysts say in a research report. Front-month WTI crude oil futures are 1.4% higher at $94.35 per barrel. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
